Srinivas Hotel in Mangalore
Hotel Srinivas is located in the heart of Mangalore city 17 kilometers away from Mangalore airport, 1 kilometer away from Mangalore railway station and 4 kilometer away from Mangalore KSRTC bus stand. Srinivas is one of the oldest hotels in Mangalore which is known for its time tested simple hospitality and homely ambiance. At srinivas Hotel, we strive to offer you an array of unique experiences âenthrall with the definition of hospitality
Accommodation- we Offers 52 specious rooms including 27 a/c rooms & 4 suits rooms with luxurious ambiance in which your comfort is our paramount concern. Suite rooms offer a private balcony, with spectacular views of the city. a/c rooms have individually controlled air condition, luxurious bathing, satellite television and STD and ISD connecting facilities.
